name: Inngest
summary: Inngest is a background job platform that runs your code as reliable, multi-step workflows and retries automatically when a step fails.

free_plan_covers.note: Free Hobby plan includes 50,000 function executions and 500,000 events ingested per month, plenty for a small app.

first_paid_usd_month.note: Pro plan starts at $99/month for 1 million executions included, then pay-as-you-go up to 20 million.

portability.note: The engine is open source and self-hostable, but functions are written with Inngest's own step.run() and createFunction() SDK.

sdk_typescript.note: The main SDK (npm install inngest) is TypeScript-first; separate official SDKs also cover Python and Go.

long_running.note: Steps checkpoint and resume, so a function can run well past 10 minutes; step.sleep() can pause up to 1 year (7 days on the free plan).

schedules.note: Cron-triggered functions are built in, defined with a cron expression and optional timezone in createFunction().

setup.step: Create a free Inngest account at inngest.com.
Install the SDK with npm install inngest and add an API route handler that calls serve().
Run the local Inngest Dev Server alongside next dev to test functions before deploying.
Before going live, create a production Event Key and Signing Key in the dashboard and add them to your environment file.

builder_notes: Wrap external calls (API requests, database writes) in step.run() so Inngest can retry just that step instead of the whole function.
Use step.sleep() or step.sleepUntil() instead of setTimeout for delays; it survives redeploys and serverless restarts.
Never set INNGEST_DEV=1 in production; it points the SDK at a local dev server and events will be silently dropped.
